brief: Make the pytest suite at ${tests} pass in full, without modifying the tests. The tests encode the Definition of Done; your job is to make the implementation under test satisfy them.

work_packages.title: Suite collects cleanly
work_packages.instructions: Ensure the test suite at ${tests} is importable and collects with no errors (no import errors, no collection errors). Run: ${runner} --collect-only -q ${tests}. Fix import paths, missing modules, and syntax errors in the code under test until collection is clean. Do NOT edit the tests.

checklist.assert: pytest collects ${tests} with no collection errors

work_packages.title: Suite passes in full
work_packages.instructions: Make every test under ${tests} pass. Run: ${runner} ${tests} -q. Edit the implementation under test only — never weaken, skip, or delete a test to make the gate pass. The suite must be fully green with zero failures.
